name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2170: A review of v2168 found that two of its three fixes did not work. THE FLOOD WAS STILL THERE: v2168 claimed to stop a runaway poller by refusing re-entry, but the not-running branch cleared the timer and set it to null BEFORE the busy branch called back in, so the guard was skipped every time and the next tick fired with no delay. The guard was dead code at its only call site, under a comment saying it had been fixed, and the measured shape is roughly 100 GET and 100 POST per second against 17772 while he plays. The waiter is rewritten so recursion is impossible: one timer started once, never restarted from inside the tick, cleared only on a relaunch that succeeded or at the ceiling, and a busy relaunch simply leaves the interval running because the next tick tries again on its own. The ceiling is counted inside the tick so every path is bounded, a second button press no longer zeros it, and a hung fetch can no longer stack. THE CALIBRATION WAS POISONED BY ONE REEL: a pooled ratio gave 0.314 across 18 reels while one of them supplied 64 percent of every classified count at 0.958, and without it the pool is 0.143. Both sit inside any sane band so a range check could never see it. The median asks what a typical reel does, which is the question the meter is really putting, and it reads 0.162. Also an expected count of zero fell through to the raw frame total while the estimate still called itself calibrated.
